A '''rice-oat-semolina burger''' is a [[Cookbook:Vegan cuisine|vegan]] version of a [[Cookbook:hamburger|hamburger]], with a patty made from rice, oats, semolina, and onions.

==Ingredients==
* [[Cookbook:Rice|Rice]]
* [[Cookbook:Oatmeal|Oat flakes]]
* [[Cookbook:Semolina|Semolina]]
* [[Cookbook:Onion|Onions]]
* Chopped [[Cookbook:paprika|paprika]] (optional)
* [[Cookbook:Maize|Maize]] (optional)
* [[Cookbook:Mushroom|Mushrooms]] (optional)
* [[Cookbook:Leek|Leek]] (optional)
* [[Cookbook:Soy Sauce|Soy sauce]] (optional)
* Spices: [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]], [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]], [[Cookbook:cumin|cumin]], [[Cookbook:oregano|oregano]], [[Cookbook:Savory|savory]] (optional)

==Procedure==
# Mix about the same volumes of rice, oat flakes and semolina.
# Add water and stir until you get a viscous substance.
# Add spices to taste.
# [[Cookbook:Chopping|Chop]] onions and leek into pieces and [[Cookbook:Frying|fry]] them with some oil, add maize, paprika and mushrooms to taste when the onions turn glassy.
# Fry in a hot, oiled pan. Use oil sparingly or the patties will be soaked in fat.
# You may want to flatten the patties a bit with the spatula.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
* The patties are also quite tasty entirely without spices, only with onions.
* The patties can make a reasonably good substitute for fried chicken meat, e.g., for salads.

== See also ==
* [[Cookbook:Hamburger|Hamburger]]
